## Teaching, supervision and mentoring

### University teaching

**RWTH Aachen University:** teaching contributions in Limnology, Data Science, Molecular Ecotoxicology, Introduction to Environmental Sciences, and interdisciplinary scientific-skills activities.

**Universidad de Antioquia:** Lecturer in River Ecology.

### Supervision and mentoring

Previous MSc co-supervision and ongoing mentoring and support for BSc, MSc and PhD researchers. Training and guidance includes experimental design, transcriptomics, ecotoxicogenomics, microbiome and metagenomics, environmental bioinformatics, reproducible workflows and ecological interpretation.

My teaching and mentoring emphasise scientific independence, reproducible analysis and the integration of field, experimental and computational approaches.
